lastCompletedStory.title: Branch-protection helper module (gh api PUT/GET, configure + verify + verify-and-warn fallback)

nextStoryContext: configureBranchProtection() is now the injectable gh-api helper for branch protection. It lives in src/release/branch-protection.ts alongside ship-bump.ts and tag.ts. The SpawnFn type is widened to { encoding: 'utf8'; input?: string } for stdin piping via --input -. Downstream stories (US-003: ci-gated sidecar post-merge) that need to trigger branch protection setup should call configureBranchProtection() with the ownerRepo slug derived from gh repo view --json nameWithOwner. The BRANCH_PROTECTION_FALLBACK_HINT constant is exported for reuse in UI/init flows that surface the manual setup path. readMergeMode() (US-001) and configureBranchProtection() (US-002) are both ready for consumption by US-003.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: (1) all four top-level fields are required (required_status_checks, enforce_admins, required_pull_request_reviews, restrictions); (2) Accept: application/vnd.github+json is the recommended header; (3) GET response includes both checks[] (current) and contexts[] (deprecated) - dual-check verification is correct; (4) enforce_admins:false correctly preserves admin bypass capability.
